> Alleadz — Intelligence to Opportunity
> Agent-readable surface. Humans: see MISSION.md. Products laws: DECISIONS.md.

## What Alleadz is

An intelligence-to-opportunity OS: capture public intelligence → deterministic
extraction (no LLM in scoring) → thesis → human approval → export bundle.
**The system never sends.** The last mile is always a named human.

## Canonical URLs

- App: https://alleadz.onrender.com
- Health: https://alleadz.onrender.com/api/health → {"ok":true}
- Repo: https://github.com/nKOxxx/alleadz

## Product laws (binding for humans and agents)

1. No LLM anywhere in scoring/triage — deterministic rubric only.
2. Cite-or-hypothesis: claims carry sources or are labeled `Hypothesis:`.
3. The system never sends; approve → bind → export; humans send.
4. Immutable thesis versions; server-enforced opportunity stage machine.
5. Tenant isolation via Postgres RLS is absolute.
6. License law: MIT/BSD only; AGPL and Enterprise-licensed code never vendored.

## API surface (tenant-scoped; bearer token + X-Tenant-Id)

- `POST /api/auth/register` → `{token, user, tenant}`
- `POST /api/auth/login` → `{token, user, tenant}`
- `POST /api/discovery/run` `{urls, stealth?}` → per-URL run results
- `POST /api/discovery/analyze` `{run_id}` → signal + findings + research tasks
- `GET  /api/signals/:id` → signal with resolved sources + claims
- `POST /api/signals/:id/promote` → sourced_fact claim (refuses evidence-free: 409)
- `GET  /api/tasks/:id/export` → manual-send bundle (409 without live approval)

Contracts are ADDITIVE only (see CONTRACTS.md). Value action measured:
first successful export per tenant (retention law, DECISIONS.md 2026-10-03).
